limitations.note: The rewrite eliminated the erroneous red/green overlap, but it also asserted red during reset and removed the original idle-to-red startup delay, shifting the output sequence the reference preserves.
The rewrite kept the port list but removed the original public state parameters, so existing instantiations that override those parameters no longer compile.
The test expected red to be asserted immediately on reset, so its passing result confirmed the rewrite's timing rather than checking that the original reset and startup behavior was preserved.
